[OpenPFC / Learn by doing]{.lesson-kicker}

# A few lines. A mathematical idea. An answer you can check.

[Read the source, change a parameter, and predict the answer.]{.lesson-deck}
:::

The teaching collection is being built from small runnable C++ programs.
Each chapter develops a mathematical argument, includes actual source,
and explains how to decide whether the answer is right.

The [coverage inventory](coverage.qmd) records every existing executable
and all forty programs from *Spectral Methods in MATLAB*. Pending entries
stay visible while the corresponding teaching chapters are developed.

The [existing examples catalogue](https://vtt-propertune.github.io/OpenPFC/docs/reference/examples_catalog/)
provides runnable entry points in the meantime.
:::
